title: QEx cross-triangle tracing produces 0 QEdges on Hand-30k despite 621 FACE QVerts
description:
Surfaced by PATCH-59 stage 2 QEx regression test. On metriko's Hand-30k stage2 UVs, our QuadVertexGenerator finds 621 FACE QVerts (consistent with metriko's quad density). All 4 cardinal ports per QVert get emitted (2484 ports total). But QuadEdgeGenerator connects ZERO of them. metriko's QEx produces 2339 quads on the same input.

The same-face mate lookup fails because integer points within one mesh triangle are usually solo (one integer point per triangle ≈ no in-face neighbour). Cross-triangle tracing must hop via TransitionMatrix to find mates in adjacent faces. Currently 0 hops succeed.

Likely culprits:
1. raySegmentIntersect's EPS = 1e-7 is too tight for the small mesh-edge segments at Hand-30k scale (similar issue to QuadVertexGenerator's collinearity bug fixed in PATCH-59 — perpendicular distance check needs absolute tolerance, not length-relative).
2. TRS construction expects the matching to be carried in CombedField; with combed=null (the default in the regression test), heR/heT defaults treat every edge as identity. metriko's stage1 matching SHOULD be threaded in to match metriko's behaviour.
3. MAX_HOPS = 64 may be too low if iso-lines wander through many small triangles.

Diagnostic: regression test prints connected port count (currently 0) — provides immediate signal on whether tracing improves with each fix attempt.
definition-of-done: MetrikoStageRegressionTest.stage2UvsThroughQexProducesQuads reports our_quad_count > 50% of metriko's 2339 (= >1170) when CombedField is wired through to QuadMeshExtractor. Existing PATCH-43/58 toy-mesh tests still pass.
testing-plan: 1. Re-run regression test after fix; confirm QEdges > 1000 + quads > 1000. 2. Spot-check: pick 3 random metriko quads from hand-quad.obj and verify our quad mesh has analogous quads (same approximate position).
